comments.author: @travellives
comments.text: Which part of everyday life in Guadeloupe surprised you most: its connection to France, food prices or Creole culture? If you live there, what would you add?

comments.author: @UnseenOutlands
comments.text: The food price comparison really surprised me. If groceries were 42% more expensive in Guadeloupe than in mainland France in 2022, how do ordinary families adjust their monthly budgets? Are local farmers and markets able to offer more affordable alternatives, or does dependence on imported goods make high prices almost unavoidable?

replies.author: @travellives
replies.text: Families often balance their budgets by combining local produce from markets with imported staples, though the reliance on shipping means higher costs for many items remain a daily reality. ✨

comments.author: @lifeonearth68
comments.text: I love how French and Creole are both part of everyday life in Guadeloupe. Do younger people still speak Creole at home with their families, or is French becoming more common?😊😊

replies.author: @travellives
replies.text: Creole remains a vital part of daily life and identity for younger generations in Guadeloupe, even as French is used in formal settings and schools. ✨
